incident.attribution: TRM private-sector intelligence attribution; source wallet labels are public attribution, not beneficial-owner proof.

daily_exchange_balance_event_window.method: Same-wallet net change across tracked exchange-labeled XRPL wallet set, direct rippled account_info daily reads around 08:00 UTC.
daily_exchange_balance_event_window.difference_interpretation: UNASSIGNED; NOT ATTRIBUTED TO DEPOSITS, WITHDRAWALS OR OTHER FLOWS

reserve_scope.interpretation: Includes cold storage, omnibus custody and wrapped backing reserves; not customer free float or official PoR.

hypotheses.statement: The Oct30 08:00 UTC -207.3M all-exchange daily same-wallet decline may include a substantial portion of the Oct29 233.46M Binance theft.
supporting_evidence: The Oct29 08:00 snapshot precedes the incident
The Oct30 08:00 snapshot follows the incident by about 12 hours
The -207.3M aggregate is 88.8% of the transfer amount
disconfirming_or_missing_evidence: No crosswalk of the five source wallets into the tracked set

hypotheses.statement: SBI VC Trade has an identifiable XRP exchange/custody footprint of 59.5M XRP across two public-labeled XRPL wallets.
hypotheses.alternative_explanation: Omnibus customer custody rather than SBI proprietary treasury.

correction.supersedes_prior_interpretation: The all-exchange -234.9M seven-day change is not the Binance theft amount. The more temporally relevant observation is the -207.3M all-exchange daily change between Oct29 08:00 and Oct30 08:00 UTC; this window contains the incident but is not a Binance-specific reconciliation.
correction.cryptoquant_prior_series: Approximately -220M Binance reserve decline remains a separate provider-specific series and is not reconciled to XRP Insights' 153-wallet Binance set.
